title: 이웃에게 주차 문제 말하기: 차 좀 빼 주시겠어요?
objective: Politely ask a neighbor to move their car and use -느라고.
summary: A resident politely asks a neighbor to move a car.
setting: Early morning at an apartment building. A white SUV is blocking Subin's car in the underground parking lot.

task.title: Read, choose, and respond
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list, and the -느라고 pattern to answer each question in Korean.

words.meaning: to block (a way or a car)
words.exampleMeaning: A truck is blocking the entrance to the alley.

words.meaning: to move your car out of a spot
words.exampleMeaning: Sorry, but could you move your car, please?

words.meaning: to park; to pull your car in
words.exampleMeaning: I'll park in front of the convenience store and wait.
I have to go to the hospital, so I'm in a bit of a hurry.

words.meaning: because I was busy doing ~ (and so couldn't do something else). Use it only with action verbs, not adjectives.
words.exampleMeaning: I was busy doing homework, so I couldn't sleep.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 저 3층에 사는 사람인데요, 혹시 주차장에 있는 흰색 SUV 주인이세요?
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I live on the 3rd floor. Are you by any chance the owner of the white SUV in the parking lot?
Yes, it's mine. What's the matter?

dialogue.korean: 그 차가 제 차 앞을 막고 있어서 차를 뺄 수가 없어요.
dialogue.meaning: That car is blocking the front of my car, so I can't get my car out.

dialogue.korean: 아, 정말 죄송해요. 어젯밤에 이삿짐을 옮기느라고 차를 빼는 걸 깜빡했어요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I'm really sorry. I was busy moving boxes last night, so I forgot to move my car.

dialogue.korean: 출근해야 해서 좀 급해요. 지금 바로 빼 주실 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I have to go to work, so I'm in a bit of a hurry. Could you move it right now?
Sure, I'll move it right now.

dialogue.korean: 감사합니다. 그리고 다음부터는 차에 꼭 연락처를 남겨 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Thank you. And from now on, please be sure to leave your phone number on your car.

exercises: Answer in Korean using the dialogue: ① 이웃은 어젯밤에 무엇을 하느라고 차를 빼는 걸 깜빡했어요? ② 수빈 씨는 마지막에 이웃에게 무엇을 부탁했어요?
Choose the right word: ① 주차할 자리가 없어서 오늘은 길가에 차를 (댔어요 / 뺐어요). ② 택배 트럭이 들어와야 하니까 차를 좀 (빼 / 대) 줄래요?
Join the two sentences with -느라고: ① 아기를 재우다 + 전화를 못 받았어요. ② 마트에서 장을 보다 + 메시지를 못 봤어요.
Say it in Korean: You are late for work. Your neighbor's car is blocking yours. Politely say you are in a hurry and ask them to move their car.
answers: ① 이삿짐을 옮기느라고 차를 빼는 걸 깜빡했어요. (이삿짐을 옮겼어요.) ② 다음부터 차에 꼭 연락처를 남겨 달라고 했어요. (연락처를 남겨 주세요.)
① 아기를 재우느라고 전화를 못 받았어요. ② 마트에서 장을 보느라고 메시지를 못 봤어요.
죄송한데 제가 좀 급해서요. 차 좀 빼 주시겠어요? (출근해야 해서 좀 급해요. 지금 차를 빼 주실 수 있어요?)
